text:
lena park: quick recap from the Q&A: multiple teams asked for a compact release checklist and exact freeze dates for API / Console / Optimize. can we lock those so squads can finalize sprint scopes? cc @jess carter
jess carter: short answer: API GA targeted for 2026-08-12, Console beta (invite-only) targeted for 2026-09-24, Optimize v1 targeted for 2026-11-10. will publish the checklist tomorrow.
omar (infra): please include hard cutoffs for infra-level changes (kernel/AMI/driver updates). we need to schedule capacity buys and avoid surprises.
jess carter: understood. tentative infra freeze windows: API 2026-07-29..2026-08-12, Console 2026-09-10..2026-09-24, Optimize 2026-10-27..2026-11-10. these are conservative; one-pager will show final dates.
mike (billing): billing/devex ask: will there be any pricing changes tied to Optimize launch (eg. discounted rates for early adopters or changes to embedding/unit billing)? need to prep docs.
jess carter: Optimize launch will include an "early-adopter" credits program for pilots and a billing FAQ. No changes to base hosted API pricing at GA. detailed offer will be in the one-pager.
lena park: can we get explicit pass/fail gates per release? PMs want deterministic acceptance criteria to sign off.
jess carter: yes. API GA gates: 72h prod-like traffic stability with >=99.9% availability, p95 latency < 200ms for common routes, and regression-free evals on 12 customer prompts. Console beta gates: RBAC + audit logs implemented, two pilot customers complete onboarding checklist, no high-severity security issues. Optimize v1 gates: validated quantization profiles for supported families, automated cost-report generation showing >=15% estimated savings on sample loads, and model-quality regression <2% on eval sets.
omar (infra): rollback plan detail: how many binary/model variants must infra keep warm to enable quick rollbacks?
jess carter: infra should stage two rollback images per model family: one full-precision baseline and one moderate-quant (4/8-bit depending on family). feature-flag controls per-tenant fallback.
mike (billing): will Optimize introduce any meter changes (new usage units) or just recommendations? billing docs need to know what hooks to add.
jess carter: Optimize v1 will be purely an insight & recommendation layer with optional auto-apply for dedicated customers. no new billing meter at launch, but recommendations may include enabling quantized variants which can reduce token compute cost. we'll provide clear guidance for billing instrumentation.
lena park: practical ask: can product publish a concise one-pager + checklist and attach the pilot onboarding form? teams need to link it in sprint planning.
jess carter: yes. publishing one-pager, owners matrix, gates checklist, and pilot sign-up form by EOD tomorrow. tagging @release-coordinator-bot to create tracking tasks. :white_check_mark:
release-coordinator-bot: Created RW-TRACK-6410 "Publish roadmap one-pager + gates: API/Console/Optimize" assigned to jess carter, lena park, omar (infra), due 2026-07-10.
lena park: thanks. last: any change to Dedicated migration SLA during Console beta? legal asked specifically about commitment windows for concierge assistance.
jess carter: Concierge assistance window will be extended for beta pilots (24/7 for first 30 days). no permanent SLA change for general Dedicated customers. details and SOW template in the one-pager.
omar (infra): i'll add infra tasks to the tracking issue and flag any blocker dates. thanks everyone.
lena park: appreciate it. i'll ping again if any PMs need clarifications after the one-pager drops. :sparkles:
